text: Subjective: 68-year-old with history of heart failure and hypertension reports worsening leg swelling and shortness of breath when walking short distances. Objective: Bilateral pitting edema to the knees, elevated jugular venous pressure, crackles at lung bases, blood pressure elevated. Plan: Increase loop diuretic dose, review sodium and fluid restriction, optimize antihypertensive therapy, and schedule echocardiogram to reassess ejection fraction.
